name: mm-income-tax
description: Myanmar individual income tax for the 2026-27 financial year (1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027) under the Union Taxation Law 2026 and the Income Tax Law. Covers the 4.8 million kyat salary exemption and its cliff, the 0% to 25% brackets, the 20% basic relief capped at 10 million kyats, parent, spouse and child reliefs, rental income at 10%, capital gains at 10% with the 10 million kyat exemption, citizens working abroad, non-resident foreigners, residence (183 days), the 30 June return and salary withholding. Use for questions about Myanmar personal income tax, salary tax, PAYE, IRD returns or kyat tax brackets.
